game.title: Rise of the Ronin
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG set in Japan in the time of the Black Ships and the shogun, from Team NINJA, released 2024-03-22. RAWG average playtime: 1 hour. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story missions, from leaving the nest to the dawn of a new Japan, and the hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Bonds and Allies
chapters.summary: Bonds, gifts, romance, Area Bonds, Bond Transfer, Bond Missions and fighting beside every ally.

chapters.title: Training and Combat Styles
chapters.summary: Dojo, horseback archery, gliding and firearms training, combat styles, stat types and every weapon.

chapters.title: Gear, Technology and the Longhouse
chapters.summary: Upgrading gear, set bonuses, Technology Development, the longhouse, money and levels.

chapters.title: The Open World
chapters.summary: Assassinations, fugitives, Completion Rewards, photograph spots, cats, Odds and Evens and retrying missions.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1340990)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Rise_of_the_Ronin
Fandom (riseoftheronin.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://riseoftheronin.fandom.com/wiki/Rise_of_the_Ronin
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); it links Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls and Trophies subpages, but only "Table of Contents" (about 380 characters) exists, so nothing was used. riseoftheronin.fandom.com answers the API, but its page links only about 10 articles (fighting styles such as "Hayabusa-ryu" and "Nioh-ryu" and some armour sets); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Roni" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1340990. 22 of 51 Steam achievements are hidden; all sit in the main story chapter. The first 13 are named like story missions ("Flying the Nest" to "The Dawn of a New Japan", falling from 83% to 26%); the last 8 ("Solitary Ronin" to "Dive of the Ronin", 14 to 49%) and "Fancy Meeting You Here" may be side stories or endings, but the data does not say. RAWG shows only 1 hour of average playtime, which looks far too low to reflect the game's real length.
